method.scope: Exhaustive frozen-default-seed pilot/development/test allocation, not an unbounded-schema or future-bank certificate.
method.serialization: Compact JSON in strict provider schema property order, literal Unicode, no trailing newline or envelope; count output text only.
method.requiredGraph: Every accepted graph separately, incident nodes only, required directed-edge source citations, no optional current/old citations. Unstated retains its exact empty gold structure.
method.supportedUnion: All gold current claims, requested old records, qualifiers and reason nodes; union of all supported accepted graphs, exact edge citations and assertion citations. Refinement cites both inherited fields and amendment.
method.extraction: Every explicit focal/distractor AST event per independent batch; schema field whitelist; local event IDs; all reason nodes/edges and frozen verbatim source quotes. No control actions: controls are outside extractionInput.
method.validation: Frozen source hashes; regenerated pilot family/gold/support equality; all generated families pass generator validators; every output passes provider schema and extraction provenance/quote validator; exact C/O gold preservation; citation addresses/occurrences derived from observed source receipts.
limits: Schemas have no maxItems/maxLength: no finite maximum over all schema-valid spellings, redundant citations, equivalent scope partitions, identifiers, or whitespace. These are grammar-derived reference structures, without artificial padding.
Development/test R3 expiry banks are provisional; fresh semantic banks are still required by the existing pre-development gate. Changed banks/allocation/schemas require recertification.
Reference receipts validate serialization/support addresses only; they make no claim about actual arm retrieval, support preservation, or paid readiness.
A-1 retains this non-adjudication preflight gate. Any failure requires a cap/budget/design amendment before paid work. No fields, edges, qualifiers or predecessor records were removed to fit.

byteGuards.note: Local conservative source guards, not provider-body/token certification; §13 serializer/tokenizer and provider framing remain external gates.

reasoning: Scope change has two current groups and at checkpoint four requests A and B: two historical records. Other changes request one predecessor; expiry has zero current claims.
Correction uses route+approval; other full records use route+approval+cap. Refinement patches cap only and inherits route+approval; answers preserve two qualifiers.

Direct/unstated/serial-2/serial-3/conjunctive/alternative classes require respectively 1/0/2/3/3/4 union edges and 2/0/3/4/4/5 nodes. E-1 deadline expiry adds the trigger alternative, giving 3 nodes and 2 union edges in the frozen direct-expiry allocation.

Each batch contains six explicit distractor events plus at most one focal event. Initial expiry batch three also has seven; idle batches have six. At most three assignments and two predecessor anchors per focal event.
No Range value, 12 distinct current values, arbitrary DNF expansion, control assertion, or additional old record is required by this grammar. Such invented combinations are not used as maxima.
